matches.quote: All edge spectra (Fig. 5(b,c)) and the map (Fig. 5(e), +7 mV) lie within about ±100 mV of E_F, i.e. within ~20 meV of the valence-band edge.
The dI/dV map is recorded at a single energy (+7 mV)... Provide maps at several energies (in the valence band, at several in-gap energies, and in the conduction band)
Neither width matches the ~300 meV bulk gap. Its origin (e.g. a zero-bias anomaly, or the substrate) is therefore unclear, yet it is used as the reference
Several pieces of evidence that would establish the topological phase are missing: - The band inversion is not probed experimentally (no ARPES or QPI).
There is no transport, spin or helicity measurement... explicitly note the absence of transport or spin-resolved confirmation.
The 'V-shaped dip between ±50 mV' at the island center... cannot be the bulk gap seen in Fig. 4.
The missing signal at part of the edge is ascribed to 'residual tip-related effects' without evidence. This weakens the robustness claim drawn from the same map.
Specify the Wannier model (projections, which layers are included)... Cite Soluyanov & Vanderbilt (2011) and/or Yu et al. (2011) for the WCC Z2 method, and name the code used
The DFT number comes from free-standing nanoribbons... How the width is defined (FWHM, decay length) and extracted is also not stated.
A 1D linearly dispersing channel has an energy-independent DOS. Its STS signature is therefore a step-like or plateau enhancement across the gap, not a narrow peak at E_F
An edge enhancement localized at E_F, at the band edge, is equally compatible with trivial edge or band-bending states, or with Fermi-level-pinned features.

notes: C16 and C8 refer to arguments in the Supplemental Material (which was not in the main text reviewed). Even so, P16 independently identified the core physical contradiction of C16 (Fig. 2b shows a linear 1D dispersion, which yields a flat DOS rather than a sharp dI/dV peak), and P3 identified that the 1.35 nm DFT nanoribbon width lacked a proper spatial decay-length definition (C8); both are scored 'partly'. P10 questions functional consistency (PBE vs HSE06) for the gap enhancement, but does not question whether the HSE06 band inversion survives GW (C22), so C22 is marked 'not raised'.
